About this product

The Uniview NVR302-16B-P16-IQ is a 16-channel network video recorder with built-in PoE for simplified IP camera deployment. It supports Ultra 265, H.265, and H.264 video compression to reduce storage and bandwidth use without compromising video quality. This NVR includes 16 independent PoE ports for direct camera connection, plug-and-play setup, and centralised power management. ONVIF support (Profiles S, G, and T) ensures compatibility with a wide range of third-party IP cameras. It offers HDMI output up to 4K and VGA for flexible display options.
